A baby tiger’s roar is more of a high-pitched squeak or mewl than the deep, commanding roar of an adult. These vocalisations help tiger cubs communicate with their mother and siblings, often signaling hunger, playfulness, or seeking attention. While not as powerful as an adult’s roar, these sounds are an adorable glimpse into the cub’s journey of learning and growing into a formidable predator.
